summary.name: VKD3D D3D12 launch and diagnostics contract
summary.goal: Make the D3D12 -> DXMT -> WineMetal -> Metal launch path explicit, testable, and diagnosable without requiring a live commercial game run.

required_env.proves: Wine loads the VKD3D DXMT D3D12/DXGI/WineMetal surface and D3D11 fallback from the staged runtime before builtin DLLs while leaving Steam overlay renderers disabled.
Game processes can find the isolated VKD3D Windows DLLs from the normal Steam prefix without borrowing the M11 DXMT surface.
The PE winemetal.dll bridge opens the app-local Unix WineMetal sidecar by basename, matching the cube-proven launch method.
Shader outputs remain in the shader cache and are not conflated with logs.
PSO/pipeline cache outputs remain separate from the shared diagnostic log.

developer_logging_env.proves: When developer graphics runtime logs are enabled, DXMT component logs and focused diagnostics write to the shared Open Logs VKD3D pipeline folder, not shader or pipeline cache directories.

pipeline_stages.flow: VKD3D selects the DXMT D3D12 node, deploys D3D12/DXGI/Winemetal plus D3D11 fallback DLLs, and keeps M11/M10/M9 as fallbacks.
The launcher combines Steam identity, DLL overrides, Wine DLL paths, app-local sidecars, cache env, optional developer VKD3D log env, and per-game compatibility env.
DXMT honors DXMT_LOG_PATH so component logs and diagnostic probes write under the per-title VKD3D pipeline log folder.
DXGI traces swapchain/factory/adapter entrypoints through the shared diagnostic logger.
D3D12 traces device, queue, swapchain, presenter, PSO, resource, and heap events through the shared diagnostic logger.
DXIL/DXBC lowering, root signature handling, binding manifests, PSO creation, corpus replay, and Metal compilation remain separately auditable.
The DX12-only stress exe exercises app handoff, SM6-style pressure, textures, vertices, PSOs, draws, presents, and readback diagnostics without a commercial game.

dev_gates.pinpoints: VKD3D launcher env, shared logging, native trace routing, source comments, and required dev gates.
VKD3D launch env, per-title logs, app-local sidecars, runtime deployment, and compatibility knobs.
Required DLLs, Unix sidecars, WineMetal ABI, prefix placement, and manifest drift.
DXIL parser/lowering, binding, PSO, corpus replay, and shader-engine evidence surfaces.
Buildable D3D12 runtime, staged runtime files, WineMetal sidecars, vkd3d_game.exe, and optional live cube run.
High-pressure DX12 app behavior through the same runtime and logging contract.

source_comments.must_contain: VKD3D should use isolated VKD3D DLL path

evidence.note: VKD3D env tests assert app-local WineMetal sidecars, DXMT overrides, and per-title shared log routing.
PR gate stages DXMT runtime files and can run the live VKD3D developer cube.
Shader engine source surfaces and offline gates remain separately validated.
